reason: The hypothesis combines MD melting simulations (P1) with CALPHAD thermodynamics (P17, P29) and MC/MD configurational entropy calculations (P3) into a single integrated protocol, and proposes validating it with both DSC and in-situ neutron imaging, a combination not found in any single passage. However, each component is taken directly from existing work, and the integration is proposed without a new mechanistic link or resolution of a conflict between the sources.
